summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on importing demographic data, specifically from Eurostat (esri). [p1] requested a query for demographics and any existing structures for country-level demographic data. [me] confirmed that there are no specific structures available, only an aggregation structure for unique users per facility, along with the script to populate it.

[me] provided the necessary SQL query and structure file location (in the stuff repo). It was clarified that [p1] needs to formulate queries to Eurostat to output CSV or JSON containing postcodes and values. [me] will then process these outputs into tables.
decisions: The demographic data import project is moving forward.
The required input format for demographics must be CSV or JSON, containing postcode and associated values.
action_items: [p1] to work on the Eurostat queries for Danish demographics.
[p1] to review the provided SQL query and unique user aggregation structure for potential data import work.
